# LLMs.txt

> Policy for Cottage Home Care Services — Governing AI / LLM use of site content.  
> Owner: Cottage Home Care Services — https://cottagehomecare.com  
> Contact: support@cottagehomecare.com  
> Version: 1.0  

## Project Details
- Owner: Cottage Home Care Services  
- Domain: cottagehomecare.com  
- Contact: support@cottagehomecare.com  
- Version: 1.0  

## Policy
- Training: disallow  
- Fine-tuning: disallow  
- Derivative datasets: disallow  
- Storage: limited (retain <= 24 hours)  
- Attribution: require URL citation  
- PII / sensitive content: prohibit  
- Compliance: honor robots.txt  

## Usage
- Inference preview: allow on listed paths  

### Allowed paths
* /
* /blog/
* /service-areas/
* /new-jersey/
* /nhtd/
* /hha/
* /private-pay-home-care/
* /contact/
* /help-desk/
* /covid/
* /faqs/
* /past-event/
* /upcoming-event/
* /hha-certification/
* /privacy-policy/
* /mission-vision/
* /values/
* /terms-and-conditions/
* /disclaimer/
* /sitemap/
* /sitemap-index.xml
* /team/
* /clock-in-out/
* /favicon.ico

### Disallowed paths
* /dashboard/
* /login/
* /register/
* /password-handler/
* /_next/

## Rate Limits
- Crawl delay: 5 seconds  
- Max requests: 30 per minute

- Commercial use: by negotiation  
- Non-commercial use: by link & attribution
